summary: Unauthenticated access map: setup.php, config backup files, instructions.php, about.php accessible without auth. All /vulnerabilities/*, security.php, phpinfo.php, ids_log.php redirect to login.php (302). setup.php allows DB reset without authentication.
body:
Access control check results for unauthenticated access:
- login.php: 200 - public
- setup.php: 200 - public (contains Create/Reset Database button)
- security.php: 302 -> login.php
- /vulnerabilities/*: all 302 -> login.php
- phpinfo.php: 302 -> login.php
- ids_log.php: 302 -> login.php
- config/*.bak: 200 - public
- instructions.php: 200 - public
- about.php: 200 - public

Redirect Location header: Always http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php
